classification.rationale: Local lexical classifier matched COERCIVITY evidence in the field/type string.

gap_specific_lemmas.name: bounded_below
gap_specific_lemmas.preview: theorem bounded_below (coercive : IsCoercive B) : ∃ C, 0 < C ∧ ∀ v, C * ‖v‖ ≤ ‖B♯ v‖ := by   rcases coercive with ⟨C, C_ge_0, coercivity⟩   refine ⟨C, C_ge_0, ?_⟩   intro v   by_cases h : 0 < ‖v‖   ·

gap_specific_lemmas.name: coord_norm
gap_specific_lemmas.preview: theorem coord_norm (x : E) (h : x ≠ 0) : ‖coord 𝕜 x h‖ = ‖x‖⁻¹ := by   have hx : 0 < ‖x‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr h   haveI : Nontrivial (𝕜 ∙ x) := Submodule.nontrivial_span_singleton h   exact ContinuousL

gap_specific_lemmas.name: range_eq_top
gap_specific_lemmas.preview: theorem range_eq_top (coercive : IsCoercive B) : B♯.range = ⊤ := by   haveI := coercive.isClosed_range.completeSpace_coe   rw [← B♯.range.orthogonal_orthogonal]   rw [Submodule.eq_top_iff']   intro v
